blocks.text: I will be out for a stretch over the holiday, and I would like the coverage settled and in writing before I go. My accounts are quiet just now, so this should be a light week for you, but I would rather it be written down than left to memory.

For the record, and so anyone checking the calendar knows where things stand, John Macias is the point of contact on my files while I am away. Anything that genuinely cannot wait should come to you first; the rest can hold until I am back. I will leave a short note on each account so you are not starting cold, and I will glance at the mailbox once or twice in case something needs a quick read.
